title: Gold in the Cracks
logline: A thumb-sized potter hides the cup she broke, until the morning sun finds the crack.
look: Windowsill workshop at night: warm tungsten lamp vs cold blue rain light; dawn turns everything honey-gold. Clay with fingerprints, stepped on 2s, face-replacement pops.
narrator: female, elderly, low pitch, british accent
A warm grandmother telling a bedtime story, gentle smile in the voice
music: Solo celesta and pizzicato strings, rain on glass; a cello enters at the break; a warm string swell at dawn.

shots.direction: ECU 100mm · rack focus glass to room · fade in — rain beads on a window; behind, a warm lamp and a tiny clay girl, Pip, asleep beside a thimble kiln
WS 35mm · locked · cut — the windowsill workshop: matchbox shelves of tiny clay cups; Pip wakes and stretches
MS 50mm · slow dolly in · cut — Pip throws a cup on a button-sized wheel, clay boiling, happy face pop
CU 85mm · hold · cut — she lifts her best cup to the lamp: perfect glossy blue
INSERT · locked · smash cut — lightning flash, the shelf shakes
CU 85mm · speed ramp to slow motion · cut — the blue cup tips and falls
ECU macro · locked · cut — a crack splits across it; all sound drops; Pip face pop to sad
MS 50mm · gentle drift · cut — Pip turns the crack to the wall and pushes the cup behind the others
WS 24mm high angle · locked · dissolve — night; Pip alone, very small, rain shadows crawling on the wall
CU 85mm · push in · cut — she opens a tiny pot of gold and dips a brush
ECU macro · slow dolly along the crack · cut — gold fills the seam, glinting
WS 35mm · locked · dissolve — dawn breaks through the window
CU 85mm · push in · cut — sunlight hits the cup; the gold seam blazes and throws a golden line across her face; she smiles
WS 35mm · slow pull back · cut — the mended cup stands at the front of the shelf; Pip asleep again in morning light; fade out

narration.text: Pip made cups for the whole windowsill.
And every cup she made was perfect.
So when one broke, she did what perfect people do.
In an old country, broken cups are mended with gold.
The crack was not the end of the cup.
It was the part that caught the morning.
